headline: Commission to review brochure update, Fair Housing plan for the City of Malden, and a recap of Public Safety Day.
summary: The meeting covers old business including a brochure update, the Fair Housing plan for the City of Malden, and a recap of recent events including Public Safety Day. Public comment and new business will also be addressed.
items: Fair Housing plan for the City of Malden
Recap of latest events: Public Safety Day

Notice of Meeting and Agenda
Virtual Meeting Only
Wednesday October 14, 2026
6:00p.m.
In accordance with the City of Malden Local Executive Order issued on January 4, 2022, regarding 
COVID-19, this meeting shall be held remotely via technological means, in the manner specified 
below (MS Teams), and no in-person attendance by members of the public is allowed.
All efforts will be made to permit remote public attendance of this virtual meeting via technological
means, in the manner specified below and if available, via public broadcast of the meeting by 
Urban Media Arts on public access television channels.
Public access will also be provided by posting draft minutes, and/or a transcript, recording, or 
recording of the meeting on the City of Malden website at www.cityofmalden.org, as soon as 
practicable after the meeting.
